about_the_game:
Shadows of Betrayal is a mystery/thriller visual novel about a group of recent high school graduates who set out for a trip to a remote cabin. The game is set in current day but with 80s/90s horror vibes.

Get to know the intriguing friend group, enjoy the banter, plot twists and optional romance, and try to survive the unexpected events in Shadows of Betrayal while solving the multi-layered mystery! Who will survive, and at what cost?

How will it all unravel? The answers lie in Shadows of Betrayal.

Features

  • Interesting story with unexpected plot twists
  • Well written characters with engaging and witty dialogue
  • Meaningful choices
  • Relationship system that gives you feedback of what people think of your actions
  • Toggleable map that shows you where the current scene is taking place
  • First person narrative

short_description: Recent high school graduates gather at a remote cabin for a celebration. What begins as a night of laughter spirals into a tense mystery full of secrets, twists, and chilling choices. Who will survive? Navigate friendships, and uncover the multi-layered mystery in Shadows of Betrayal.
